\iiint_\Omega z\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\varphi\int_0^1r\cos\varphi\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr=2\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos\varphi\sin\varphi\,d\varphi\int_0^1r^3\,dr=\frac{\pi}{4}.
